import { get_timeline, preview_timeline_frame, render_timeline } from "@nodetool-ai/sandbox-nodetool/timelines";const id="210f92ac67a9";
const state=await get_timeline({timeline_id:id});let preview;try{preview=await preview_timeline_frame({timeline_id:id,times_ms:[500],width:640});}catch(e){preview={error:String(e)}}console.log(JSON.stringify(preview));let render;try{render=await render_timeline({timeline_id:id,wait:true,timeout_ms:120000});}catch(e){render={error:String(e)}}return {state,preview,render};
